arStrings.szText:
{icon:bullet,1.2} You deal {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%x|]{/c} increased Shadow and Cold damage. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} Enemies who are Corrupted or Frostbitten for more than their remaining life are permanently {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u}, {c_important}{u}Weakened{/c}{/u}, Slowed by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c}, take {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"|%x|]{/c} increased damage from you, and are Feared every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
